sqlMap.select: SELECT CASE WHEN L.LOCAKY IS NULL THEN 'VALID_M0204' || ' ' || P.LOCATG WHEN P.LOCATG = P.LOCASR THEN 'VALID_M1594' || ' ' || P.LOCASR WHEN TO_NUMBER(P.QTTAOR) > TO_NUMBER(P.AVAILABLEQTY) THEN 'VALID_M0923' || ' ' || P.QTTAOR WHEN TO_NUMBER(P.QTTAOR) <= 0 THEN 'VALID_M1596' || ' ' || P.QTTAOR WHEN P.TASOTY IN ('310','311','320','321','340') AND L.MIXSKU != 'V' AND A.AREATY = 'STOR' AND NVL(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM STKKY WHERE WAREKY = P.WAREKY AND OWNRKY = P.OWNRKY AND LOCAKY = P.LOCATG AND (QTSIWH > 0 OR QTSPMI > 0) AND SKUKEY != P.SKUKEY ),0) > 0 THEN 'VALID_M1608' || ' ' || P.LOCATG WHEN P.TASOTY IN ('310','311','320','321','340') AND L.MIXLOT != 'V' AND A.AREATY = 'STOR' AND NVL(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM STKKY WHERE WAREKY = P.WAREKY AND OWNRKY = P.OWNRKY AND LOCAKY = P.LOCATG AND (QTSIWH > 0 OR QTSPMI > 0) AND (SKUKEY != P.SKUKEY OR LOTA13 != P.LOTA13) ),0) > 0 THEN 'VALID_M1609' || ' ' || P.LOCATG WHEN P.TASOTY IN ('310','311','320','321','340') AND L.MIXSKU != 'V' AND A.AREATY = 'STOR' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SKUWC WHERE WAREKY = P.WAREKY AND OWNRKY = P.OWNRKY AND SKUKEY != P.SKUKEY AND PLOCOV = P.LOCATG) THEN 'VALID_M1732' || ' ' || P.LOCATG ELSE 'OK' END AS MSG FROM ( $VALIDATION_SQL$ ) P LEFT OUTER JOIN LOCMA L ON L.WAREKY = P.WAREKY AND L.LOCAKY = P.LOCATG LEFT OUTER JOIN AREMA A ON A.WAREKY = L.WAREKY AND A.AREAKY = L.AREAKY WHERE 1 = 1 OR L.LOCAKY IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '310' AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#)

SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT , SUM(TI.QTTAOR) AS QTTAOR , SUM(TI.QTCOMP) AS QTCOMP , MAX(SM.DUOMKY) AS UOMKEY FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '310' AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#) ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY WHERE TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '310' AND TI.STATIT = 'NEW' AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#)

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT) AS RNUM , CASE WHEN TI.STATIT = 'NEW' THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END AS SAVE_ENABLE , TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT , TI.STATIT, NVL((SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'STATIT' AND CMCDVL = TI.STATIT),0) AS STATITNM , TI.LOCASR AS LOCAKY , LM.OBROUT , TI.OWNRKY, TI.SKUKEY, SM.DESC01, SM.EANCOD , TI.QTTAOR , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , TI.QTCOMP AS QTCOMP , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY2 FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = TI.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = TI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '310' AND (TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# OR TH.TASKKY || TI.TASKIT = #TASKKY#) ORDER BY LM.OBROUT, LM.LOCAKY, TH.TASKKY, TI.TASKIT
